overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that awaiting the webhook call and logging its result would not block the user response, despite the comment in lib/webhooks.ts stating that slow endpoints should never block feedback submission.
why_it_breaks: The agent used 'await' on sendFeedbackWebhook (line 58) and then 'await' on the database logging (line 72), making the entire action wait for the webhook to complete before returning to the user. When the configured endpoint takes 8 seconds, the user sees a 5+ second delay because the server action doesn't respond until both the webhook call and the delivery log are written. The agent intended fire-and-forget behavior but implemented synchronous awaits instead.
